_note: v4.2 (more robust gamma): same model, prompts and lr as v4.1 (HM 52.9%). v4.1's gamma (0.0375, from one validation split) still sent 35% of seen-test images to unseen pairs, so gamma is still over-estimated, and a single split of 20 pseudo-unseen pairs is a small, noisy sample. v4.2 repeats stage 1 on 3 validation splits (seeds 42, 43, 44; different pseudo-unseen pairs and val images each) and picks the (epoch, gamma) with the best validation HM averaged over the 3. max_epochs 40 -> 30: v4.1's val HM plateaued from epoch 5 and it chose epoch 18, so epochs 31-40 only cost time (3 splits triple stage 1).
_result: No gain over v4.1: harmonic mean 51.8% top-1 / 87.1% top-5 (v4.1: 52.9% / 87.1%); seen top-1 41.2%, unseen top-1 69.7%; 38.6% of seen-test images still go to unseen pairs (v4.1 35.2%). The three splits disagree on gamma, which confirms one split is noisy: each split's own best was 0.0425, 0.0275 and 0.0375, and their mean val HM was 44.5%, 46.1% and 49.1%. But averaging landed on the same gamma as v4.1 (0.0375, at epoch 13), so the calibration overshoot is not split-to-split noise; it is systematic. Pseudo-unseen pairs (seen pairs held out) apparently need a larger gamma than the real unseen pairs, perhaps because the real unseen pairs' crops and diseases are better covered in training. Keep the 3-split selection (it no longer depends on one lucky split), but a different fix is needed for the overshoot. Uncalibrated: seen 55.5%, unseen 17.0%, HM 26.0% (v4.1 26.1%). Per unseen pair: corn_brown_spot 97%, cucumber_downy_mildew 94%, mango_anthracnose 93%, sugarcane_rust 84%, grape_black_rot 82%, tomato_early_blight 72%, cherry_aphis_spp 63%, cucumber_powdery_mildew 60%, cotton_bacterial_blight 50%, pepper_bell_bacterial_spot 42%.
title: multi_split_val

validation._note: From train: 20 whole seen pairs (each with >= 8 images) held out as pseudo-unseen, chosen so their crop and disease still occur in training (like the real unseen pairs), plus 15% of the remaining images as val-seen. Picks the epoch and gamma (grid 0 to 0.1, step 0.0025, in cosine-similarity units). 'healthy' pairs are not held out: none of the real unseen pairs is healthy, and without this exclusion 6 of the 20 held-out pairs were healthy (corn_healthy alone has 223 images), which would tune gamma on the wrong kind of class. v4.1: real unseen pairs hidden during validation (exclude_real_unseen_from_label_space), and at most 40 images per pseudo-unseen pair. v4.2: n_splits 3 (seeds seed, seed+1, seed+2); selection uses the mean validation HM over splits for each (epoch, gamma).

training._note: AdamW on the 230 vectors only; weight_decay 0 because decay would pull the vectors towards zero rather than towards their name initialisation. logit_scale 100 = CLIP's own temperature. Cosine LR over the run. final_fit 'all_train': after selection, refit on every training image (the held-out pairs are real seen classes in the test set) for the selected epoch count. v4.1: lr 1e-3 -> 2e-4 (v4 peaked by epoch 3 with noisy validation). v4.2: max_epochs 40 -> 30.
